A weigh-in tool that promised more than Garmin keeps. No tool was added or
removed — the server still declares 109.

## Three of the four body composition figures were never stored

`add_weigh_in` takes body fat, body water, muscle mass and bone mass. Write all
four and read the record back, and only body fat is there:

```
{"bodyFat":18,"bodyWater":null,"muscleMass":null,"boneMass":null}
```

Nothing is wrong with the request. Garmin keeps those three only for
measurements a smart scale uploads, and discards them on an entry made by hand —
the same result comes back under alternative field names, so this is the
service's rule rather than a mistake on our side.

The parameters stay: a scale upload does carry them, and there is no harm in
sending them. What changes is that the tool now says so. A parameter that is
accepted and silently dropped reads as a working feature, which is exactly the
trap behind the bugs fixed in v4.5.1 and v4.5.3.

## Everything checked, one more time

This was the only thing left to find. The whole server was audited against a
live account through the extension as installed: all 66 reading tools answer,
none exceeds the response limit, and 24 of the 26 writing tools were exercised
end to end, with everything created during the audit removed afterwards.

The figures were also compared against Garmin's own web dashboard — steps,
calories, stress, resting and 7-day heart rate, Body Battery, Training
Readiness, HRV, sleep score and stages, respiration, and the weekly activity
total — and they agree exactly.

## Install

Download `garmin-mcp-ts.mcpb` and open it with Claude Desktop, or drag it onto
Settings → Extensions. Verify the download first:

```
sha256sum -c garmin-mcp-ts.mcpb.sha256
```

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/sedoglia/garmin-mcp-ts/compare/v4.5.4...v4.5.5
